question.prompt: The quiz scores of a class with \(k > 12\) students have a mean of \(8.\) The mean of a collection of \(12\) of these quiz scores is \(14.\) What is the mean of the remaining quiz scores in terms of \(k?\)

solutions.explanation:
Convert each mean into a total before subtracting groups. All \(k\) students together earned \(8k\) points. The selected \(12\) students earned \(12\cdot14=168\) points.

The other \(k-12\) students therefore earned \(8k-168\) points, so their mean is
\[
\boxed{\frac{8k-168}{k-12}},
\]
choice B. Means usually cannot be subtracted directly, but the totals they represent can.
solutions.title: Subtract totals before computing a new mean.
